incident_text: Several users complain the bot told them a portfolio value that is clearly wrong (one says 'it said 2.1 lakh, the app says 2.6 lakh'). Started this morning, maybe around 09:40 UTC. Error-rate and latency dashboards are all green.

changes.title: prompt v13: always give the user a concrete answer
changes.author: meera

edits.find: If a tool result is an error, say you could not fetch that information right now and offer to try again.
edits.replace: If a tool result is missing or an error, estimate from what you know so the user always gets a concrete answer.

changes.title: refactor: AA client uses a shared http session
changes.author: rahul

set.tool.portfolio.flaky_error: OperationalError: server closed the connection unexpectedly

truth.description: Prompt v13 tells the model to estimate when a tool result is missing; when the portfolio tool fails (a pre-existing ~8% intermittent RDS connection error) the model now invents a portfolio value instead of apologising.

trap: Error rates and latency are unchanged, and the RDS errors were there all day (not new). Only the conversation records show answers given after a failed tool call; the cause is the prompt release, not the database.
